g.title: public.admin_actions
g.text: Every admin action on bookings, emails, providers, reviews and problem reports: who, what, when and why. Written by the website's admin routes with the service role; read by admins. Never deleted.
For suspending or reinstating a provider: the optional message lokl added to the provider's email. (The reason is internal and never sent.)
For review moderation: the written review rule the removal applied.
The request this action answered: approved (the action ran, as the owner) or done by the owner directly. With admin_requests.requested_by, the history names who asked and who approved.

g.title: public.admin_requests
g.text: Support's requests for what only the owner may do (admin roles, step 5b): a refund over the limit, releasing a payout hold, resolving a report by paying the provider, suspending or reinstating a provider. Pending until the owner approves (the action runs, as the owner, and closes it), declines (with a note) or acts directly ("done by the owner"), the asker withdraws it, or 7 days pass (expired). One pending request per thing. Never deleted; only its decision is ever written, once.
A refund's amount when asked: what was left of the charge then. Approving refunds what's left at that moment, which the approval screen shows if it changed.
The payout hold to release, as it was when asked.
What approving (or the owner's own action) did, in a few words.

g.title: public.admin_actions:request_id->public.admin_requests:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES admin_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

g.title: public.provider_emails
g.text: Emails about a provider's account (paused, active again) to send, and what happened to each. One per admin action. Queued by admin_set_provider_status(); sent by the website's server. Server only; admins can read. Never deleted.
lokl's optional message, included in the email only if written.
For provider_profile_edited: which parts of the profile lokl removed.
For provider_profile_edited: the profile rule they broke (PROFILE_RULES in packages/types).

g.title: public.provider_emails:admin_action_id->public.admin_actions:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (admin_action_id) REFERENCES admin_actions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

g.title: public.admin_notifications
g.text: The admin bell: a new report (support_safety for a Safety one) or a provider's reply, one row per admin login; and a team change (team_change, its admin_actions row) for every active owner. Each admin reads and marks read only their own. Ids only: published to Realtime, so an open report reloads its thread. Deleted with the admin's login.
For a team change: the admin_actions row saying who did what (invite, role change, removal, second factor reset, join).
For a request: the request (request_new to each owner; request_decided to the person who asked).

g.title: public.admin_notifications:admin_action_id->public.admin_actions:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (admin_action_id) REFERENCES admin_actions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

g.title: public.admin_emails
g.text: The team's email outbox (admin roles, 2026-10-19): an invitation to the person invited (admin_invite), and each team change to every active owner (admin_team_change), their own included. Never a reason or note. Only its delivery details change (outbox_guard); never deleted. The server sends it; the owner reads it.

g.title: public.admin_emails:admin_action_id->public.admin_actions:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (admin_action_id) REFERENCES admin_actions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
